title: Public multiplayer lobby preview in portrait layout
summary: The public multiplayer course preview remains legible in the 390×844 portrait lobby; host and guest clients synchronize the selected Sausalito name and its stadium artwork.
details: This portrait capture is part of the public all-40 gate: 39 source preview pairs plus the separately authored Training fallback. Host and guest lobby artwork synchronized across all course choices.
The public browser check used Chromium at 390×844; this is not a physical-phone capture. Public deployment hashes matched the 510-object / 45-static-file release at ebae742.
limitation: The screenshot documents one Sausalito lobby view and does not imply original PST art for Training or full multiplayer/game equivalence.
caption: Public HTTPS Chromium portrait lobby (390×844): Sausalito, the source stadium preview, player count and lobby action fit the screen; this is not a physical-phone capture.
